summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on July 14, 2026, containing a second-quarter 2026 trading statement that provides updated estimates and guidance for earnings, production, segment performance, and financial metrics such as net debt and effective tax rate. The filing discusses operational updates including seasonal maintenance, production disruptions, realizations, marketing and trading results, exploration write-offs, and other financial considerations like hybrid bond redemptions and settlement liabilities. It is a routine earnings update, not a special situation filing, and does not involve any M&A, activism, restructuring, or corporate action.
